If you want to know how to build bigger biceps, how to get bigger biceps, or how to build big biceps that look thicker from every angle, this video shows you why simply doing more curls may not be the answer. You can perform barbell curls, dumbbell curls, preacher curls, hammer curls and cable curls every week, but if the mechanics are wrong, you can still leave biceps growth on the table.
